replies.author: Matic0B
replies.body:
Gameplay Issues:
 - Main island is very small
 - Difficult navigation to side islands as there are no premade paths / bridges. Assuming those are monuments, it doesn't really help players defend.
 - Lack of "defending materials" in spawn kit. Nothing to make fences/buttons/pressure plates out of. I recommend adding stone and removing the iron axes in the spawn kit as theres pretty much no wood on the map that I can see.
 - The player count (20v20) is too big for this map.

Aesthetic Issues:
 - Using the nether palette can be very difficult but its possible to make it work. You did not.
 - More detailing could be done to give the map a nicer look overall.
 - The sides of islands are not decorated.
 - Middle island could use some work
 - Lack of light. Could be solved with glowstone
